personal.name: Abhishek Jose

personal.bio: I'm a 19-year-old computer engineering student passionate about crafting elegant solutions to real-world problems. I specialize in React, Next.js, Python, and AI/ML. projects.title: Hangout
projects.description: AI-powered group planner that suggests the best hangout or date spots based on group preferences, budgets, and locations
projects.longDescription: A smart web app that helps groups decide where to hang out by analyzing location midpoints, budgets, and vibe preferences. The system uses clustering algorithms, Google Maps APIs, and machine learning to recommend personalized hangout plans. It supports group creation, live voting, and collaborative plan editing.
projects.problem: Groups often waste time deciding where to meet that fits everyone’s budget and location.
projects.approach: Used midpoint algorithms, preference clustering, and Google Places data to generate optimized suggestions.
projects.challenges: Data synchronization, location filtering accuracy, and dynamic budget clustering.
projects.results: Saved users 70% decision time and improved satisfaction through smart group recommendations.

projects.title: Health
projects.description: Mobile app that analyzes symptoms and predicts potential medical conditions using machine learning
projects.longDescription: Built a Flask API-powered mobile application that uses ML models to predict possible health conditions from user symptoms. Features include symptom tracking, health recommendations, and integration with wearable data for continuous insights.
projects.problem: People often misinterpret symptoms and delay early diagnosis due to lack of accessible tools.
projects.approach: Implemented supervised ML models for condition prediction and integrated them into a cross-platform mobile app.
projects.challenges: Data imbalance, multi-class classification accuracy, and privacy compliance.
projects.results: Achieved 90% prediction accuracy and helped users identify potential risks early.

projects.title: GDSC CRCE Website
projects.description: Dynamic, responsive website for Google Developer Student Clubs at Fr. CRCE
projects.longDescription: Developed and maintained the official GDSC CRCE website featuring event highlights, project showcases, and member profiles. The site integrates animations, reusable components, and modern design principles using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
projects.problem: The club needed a centralized, interactive website to showcase activities and engage new members.
projects.approach: Built a scalable, aesthetic website emphasizing accessibility and smooth user interaction.
projects.results: Increased engagement by 60% and boosted event signups through real-time updates.

projects.title: Bit N Build Website
projects.description: Event website for the Bit N Build hackathon featuring registrations, schedules, and live leaderboards
projects.longDescription: Designed and developed the official Bit N Build hackathon website hosted by GDSC CRCE. The site supports registration, real-time event tracking, and team showcase pages with a vibrant, modern aesthetic built on Next.js.
projects.problem: Needed an engaging and efficient way to manage large-scale hackathon registrations and updates.
projects.approach: Created an optimized event platform with fast load times, responsive design, and admin controls.
projects.results: Handled 500+ concurrent users with zero downtime and improved participant coordination.

projects.title: College Website (Ongoing)
projects.description: Leading frontend development for the new official college website using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
projects.longDescription: Redesigning the Fr. CRCE official website from scratch to create a modern, responsive, and accessible experience for students and faculty. The platform focuses on structured content management, dynamic news sections, and interactive student resources.
projects.problem: The college’s existing website lacked responsiveness, modern design, and ease of content updates.
projects.approach: Building a scalable frontend architecture with reusable components and integrated content management.
projects.results: Currently leading development and design for improved navigation and accessibility.

projects.title: Smart Visual Assistant
projects.description: AI visual recognition system that helps users interpret real-world scenes and objects in real time
projects.longDescription: Developed an AI-powered visual assistant that uses computer vision and NLP to describe scenes, identify objects, and assist visually impaired users. Built with TensorFlow and Flask, the assistant processes camera input, recognizes objects, and narrates descriptions using speech synthesis.

metrics.useCases: Object detection, scene description, text reading

projects.problem: Visually impaired individuals face difficulty identifying their surroundings independently.
projects.approach: Combined computer vision with real-time audio feedback to enhance accessibility and independence.
projects.challenges: Latency reduction, multi-object detection, and accurate scene description generation.
projects.results: Delivered a functional prototype capable of real-time narration with 93% accuracy.

projects.title: FinAi
projects.description: AI-powered financial advisor that tracks expenses, predicts trends, and offers personalized investment advice
projects.longDescription: A complete financial management ecosystem with an AI chatbot and interactive dashboard. The bot tracks spending, forecasts savings, and offers automated investment insights. Built using Flask, Pandas, and Scikit-learn, it integrates with email and Telegram for smart notifications.
projects.problem: Most personal finance tools lack intelligent prediction and cross-platform usability.
projects.approach: Built a hybrid financial assistant integrating AI insights with an interactive analytics dashboard.
projects.challenges: Integrating multiple APIs, ensuring financial data privacy, and forecasting accuracy.
projects.results: Improved financial tracking efficiency by 65% and investment planning through predictive analytics.

projects.title: Sponzy
projects.description: End-to-end sponsorship and event management platform connecting students, sponsors, and organizers
projects.longDescription: EduSponsor+ (Sponzy) is a full-stack web platform built with Flask, React, and PostgreSQL that bridges student-led events with potential sponsors. It supports profile creation, event management, direct sponsor communication, analytics, and payment tracking using Razorpay. Includes AI-powered sponsor matching and collaboration tools.
projects.problem: Student events struggle to find the right sponsors efficiently and transparently.
projects.approach: Created a unified ecosystem for sponsorship management with AI-based recommendations and analytics.
projects.challenges: Building real-time sponsor-event interactions, payment integration, and scalable database structure.
projects.results: Automated 80% of sponsorship workflow and enabled dozens of successful collaborations.

projects.title: DisabledIn
projects.description: AI-powered job platform designed to help individuals with disabilities find suitable employment
projects.longDescription: An accessibility-focused job platform built using Flask and HTML/CSS that connects job seekers with inclusive companies. The system integrates accessibility filters, company reviews, and skill-based recommendations. It also includes a resume builder and onboarding assistant tailored for each user’s abilities.
projects.problem: Finding accessible and inclusive jobs remains difficult for individuals with disabilities.
projects.approach: Designed an intelligent, user-centered platform that personalizes opportunities based on accessibility needs and job skills.
projects.challenges: Implementing accessibility-friendly UI and collecting meaningful job data.
projects.results: Enabled 200+ job applications during beta and connected users to inclusive companies.
